title: Add GAANA BANANA to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [GAANA BANANA](https://gaana.namansoni.in) to video_audio
- # Gaana Banana AI se apna gaana banaiye — India ka personalized AI song maker. Naam likho, theme chuno, 1-2 minute mein vocals wala poora gaana ready. Perfect gift for birthdays, anniversaries, love, 

Fixes #15636

gist.headline: A banana joins the band
gist.blurb: GAANA BANANA has joined the video-and-audio app garden. Give it a name and a theme, and it makes a personalized song with vocals in about 1–2 minutes.
gist.summary: Added GAANA BANANA to the video_audio app listing, where people can discover an India-focused AI song maker that turns a name and theme into a personalized song with vocals in about 1–2 minutes.
gist.impact: Visitors can now find GAANA BANANA through the app listing and make songs for birthdays, anniversaries, and other occasions.
gist.visual_concept: GAANA BANANA is a personalized song-making app; a banana-shaped microphone, musical notes, and a name-and-theme card convey its purpose without inventing a mascot. Polli, wearing tiny headphones, listens beside a flowering code-plant.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears tiny headphones and listens to a banana-shaped microphone singing beside a card marked 'NAME + THEME,' with musical notes blooming from lime green (#ecf874) flower pots. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
